title: The Feedlot Belt
text: Nebraska and Kansas feedlots held 4.79 million cattle on Sept. 1, 2026. That is 43% of the 11.2 million head on US lots with 1,000 or more head.

title: Largest State Herd
text: Texas had 12.1 million cattle and calves on Jan. 1, 2026, the most of any state. That is about one in seven head in the US.

title: Grass-Held Dunes
text: The Nebraska Sand Hills cover about 13.2 million acres, the largest sand dune area in the Western Hemisphere. More than 90% of the land is native grassland grazed by livestock.
source_label: USDA NRCS, Ecological Site Description R065XY022NE (MLRA 65, Nebraska Sand Hills)

title: Public Range
text: The Bureau of Land Management permits livestock grazing on 155 million acres of public land. In 2026 ranchers pay $1.69 per animal unit month, a month of forage for one cow and calf.
source_label: US Bureau of Land Management, Livestock Grazing on Public Lands

title: Corn for Feed
text: Animal feed typically takes about 40% of the corn used in the US. Demand rises and falls with the number of cattle, hogs and poultry being fed.
source_label: USDA ERS, Feed Grains Sector at a Glance

title: Last Tallgrass
text: Tallgrass prairie once covered 170 million acres of North America. Less than 4% remains intact, mostly in the Kansas Flint Hills.
source_label: National Park Service, Tallgrass Prairie National Preserve

title: Top Supplier
text: Australia was the largest source of US beef imports in 2025. It shipped 1.33 billion pounds, 25% of the total.
source_label: USDA ERS, Livestock and Meat International Trade Data (beef and veal imports, carcass weight, 2025)

title: Second Supplier
text: Canada shipped 1.01 billion pounds of beef to the US in 2025. That was 19% of US beef imports, second only to Australia.
source_label: USDA ERS, Livestock and Meat International Trade Data (beef and veal imports, carcass weight, 2025)

title: Third Supplier
text: Brazil shipped 931 million pounds of beef to the US in 2025. That was 17% of US beef imports, third behind Australia and Canada.
source_label: USDA ERS, Livestock and Meat International Trade Data (beef and veal imports, carcass weight, 2025)

title: Forest to Pasture
text: Brazil's Amazon lost 49.1 million hectares of forest from 1985 to 2024. Over the same years pasture grew by 43.8 million hectares, more than any other human land use.

title: Fourth Supplier
text: Mexico shipped 710 million pounds of beef to the US in 2025. That was 13% of US beef imports, fourth among suppliers.
source_label: USDA ERS, Livestock and Meat International Trade Data (beef and veal imports, carcass weight, 2025)
